_about: Inputs of experiments step 1 (docs/clip-recorder-experiments-plan.md, F6, F7, Procedure step 1). Read by corpus/render.mjs and spec/run-spec.mjs.
text_regions_about: M7: fixed text regions per text scenario where R is read (way D), in window pixels at sigma 1 (the probe scales them by sigma): insets from the left, top, right and bottom edges, then optional caps max_width, max_height (px) and max_width_fraction (of the window width). From the pages: typing = the inside of #box (body padding 16 + border 1 + padding 14); scroll = the text column (body padding 40 px left and right, p max-width 900); ui = the menu bar (#bar, about 36 px high) and the list (#main padding 14 18 below the bar, #list 46 % wide).
